blurb:
We are Local Guides that live in Niagara Falls, Canada and work here!

Enjoy an immersive experience featuring the great wonder of the world like never before with a fully guided walking tour that includes the World-famous Niagara City Cruises boat tour. Feel the mist, experience the moment through the Niagara River up to Niagara Falls.

The most experienced tour guides in Niagara will take you as close as possible to this powerful natural icon.

We meet at a convenient central location, the Niagara Parks Welcome Centre (5146 Murray Street) to make sure you’re one of the first in line at every stop.

• Take a ride on the world-famous Niagara City Cruises boat ride up to the Waterfall

• All-inclusive guided sightseeing walking tour of Niagara Falls

• Get spectacular views of all 3 falls (Canadian/Horseshoe, American and Bridal)

• Learn fascinating stories about the history of Niagara Falls

• See and learn about over 20 other landmarks along the way
